content.short: Trade directly between crypto, fiat currencies and precious metals on Uphold, without converting to dollars first.
content.description: Uphold's main feature is anything-to-anything trading. Instead of selling to dollars first, a user can go straight from one asset to another, for example from bitcoin to gold. Beyond trading, it supports global payments, staking, a multisig vault for long-term storage and APIs for businesses that want to embed crypto. Uphold publishes its reserves in real time and holds licences in several jurisdictions. It reports serving more than 140 countries with over 300 currencies, and has powered tens of billions of dollars in transactions since its 2015 launch.
